decisions.rationale: It omits BN and conflates variants on MR: M-static decreased MR BLEU, whereas only M-dynamic improved it slightly.
It explicitly reports that no significance tests were conducted, correctly conveying that statistical reliability was not established.
“Mixed” summarizes only M-dynamic and omits both the language-specific pattern and M-static results required by the finding.
The passage reports M-dynamic’s DE and ZH improvements but omits the finding’s contrasting M-static results.
The comparison reports increases for only BLEU, COMET-KIWI, and XCOMET, omitting the required COMET increase.
The passage correctly covers M-dynamic on DE and ZH but does not report the finding’s mixed M-static results.
It reports lower values without FILTER/NN for three metrics but omits COMET, so the all-four-metric finding is not fully reported.
